# ForgeSpec MCP (Complete Technical Reference)

> The coordination backbone for multi-agent AI development. MCP Server for Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — provides typed contract validation, SQLite-backed task board management, granular authority control (`task-authority@1.0.0`), and advisory file locking to coordinate work across multiple AI agents. Built on the Model Context Protocol SDK with better-sqlite3 and Zod schema validation.

## Why ForgeSpec?

Building software with multiple AI agents introduces coordination challenges that don't exist in single-agent workflows:

| Problem | Without ForgeSpec | With ForgeSpec |
|---------|-------------------|----------------|
| Conflicting edits | Two agents modify the same file, causing merge conflicts | File reservation leases with TTL prevent edit conflicts |
| No shared context | Each agent works in isolation | Contract validation creates shared audit trail |
| Unstructured work | Agents jump to code without specs | 9-phase pipeline enforces structured flow |
| Lost progress | No way to resume after failure | SQLite task board persists state across sessions |
| No quality gates | Code ships without validation | Confidence thresholds block premature transitions |
| Unauthorized mutations | Any agent can mutate any task/board | Authority grants/handoffs (`task-authority@1.0.0`) enforce zero-trust bounds |

**Key advantages:**
- Zero infrastructure — Embedded SQLite database, no external services required
- Universal compatibility — Any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw)
- Instant setup — One command: `npx -y forgespec-mcp@1.5.2`
- Battle-tested pipeline — 9 phases with confidence thresholds
- Full audit trail — Every contract, task, grant, revocation, and reservation is logged with timestamps
- Cross-platform — Tested on Ubuntu, Windows, macOS with Node 22, 24, 26 (primary Node 24.18.1)
- Cortex-ready — Native integration with [Cortex](https://github.com/lleontor705/cortex) for persistent memory and knowledge graph

## Recommended: Pair with Cortex

ForgeSpec manages the **workflow** (contracts, tasks, file locks, authority). [Cortex](https://github.com/lleontor705/cortex) manages the **memory** (observations, knowledge graph, session continuity). Together they form a complete multi-agent coordination stack:

- **ForgeSpec** validates SDD contracts, manages task dependencies, enforces authority grants, prevents file conflicts
- **Cortex** stores artifacts as observations, connects them via knowledge graph, enables session recovery
- Artifacts saved with `type: "cortex"` are persisted to Cortex via `mem_save` and linked with `mem_relate`
- ForgeSpec works standalone without Cortex — artifacts can also use `type: "openspec"` (filesystem) or `type: "inline"` (returned in response)

## Overview

forgespec-mcp is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server designed for multi-agent AI development workflows. It enforces a structured 9-phase development pipeline through typed contracts, manages tasks with intelligent dependency resolution, and provides advisory file locking and authority delegation for agent coordination.

**Key characteristics:**
- TypeScript, compiled to ES2022 with Node16 module resolution
- SQLite database with WAL mode for concurrent access and PRAGMA qualification
- Zod runtime schema validation for all inputs and outputs
- Official MCP Tool Annotations (`readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`) on all 30 tools
- In-memory/SQLite rate limiting per actor identity to prevent runaway mutation loops
- Runs as a stdio MCP transport (launched by client applications)
- Node.js >= 22 required (22.x, 24.x, 26.x supported; primary Node 24.18.1)

## Installation and Usage

### Using npx (no installation required)

```bash
npx -y forgespec-mcp@1.5.2
```

### Install globally

```bash
npm install -g forgespec-mcp@1.5.2
```

## Inventory of 30 MCP Tools

### 1. Capability & Diagnostic Tools (3)
- `forgespec_capabilities`: Negotiate API/schema versions, capabilities, limits, and coordination mode (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `forgespec_health`: Get server health diagnostics, SQLite integrity status (`PRAGMA quick_check`), system time, active file lease count, board/task counts, and version telemetry (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_audit_log`: Query historical audit trail of authority grants, revocations, and approval decisions (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).

### 2. SDD Contract Tools (5)
- `sdd_validate`: Validate an SDD contract against phase schema with confidence check (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `sdd_save`: Validate and persist an SDD contract to SQLite (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `sdd_get`: Retrieve a single contract by ID (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `sdd_list`: List contracts with optional project/phase filters (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `sdd_history`: Get phase transition history for a project (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).

### 3. Task Board Tools (19)
- `tb_create_board`: Create a new task board with optional inline tasks (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_add_task`: Add a task with priority, spec reference, acceptance criteria, and dependencies (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: false`).
- `tb_status`: Get board status with tasks grouped by status (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_claim`: Claim a task for execution (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: false`).
- `tb_update`: Update task status and append timestamped notes (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_unblocked`: List tasks ready to work on with resolved dependencies (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_get`: Get full task details by ID (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_list_boards`: List task boards; with direct-v1 actor context, includes owned or actively granted direct-v1 boards (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_set_dependencies`: Set normalized dependency edges (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_heartbeat`: Renew an active attempt lease (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_recover_claims`: Recover expired claims (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_requeue`: Requeue a recovered task (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_approve`: Record an immutable approval decision with asserted provenance (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_grant`: Create an attenuated, expiring task-authority grant (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_handoff`: Create a reference-only attenuated handoff (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_revoke`: Append an authority revocation without changing board ownership (`readOnlyHint: false, destructiveHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_query`: Query snapshot task pages with signed compound cursors (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_batch_status`: Read bounded board/work-unit status (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).
- `tb_events`: Read authority-event deltas (`readOnlyHint: true, idempotentHint: true`).

### 4. File Reservation Tools (3)
- `file_reserve`: Reserve files or glob patterns with TTL (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `file_release`: Release file reservations (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).
- `file_renew`: Renew an active direct-v1 file lease (`readOnlyHint: false, idempotentHint: true`).

---

## Environment Variables

- `FORGESPEC_DIR` (default `~/.forgespec`): Directory for database storage.
- `FORGESPEC_DB` (default `~/.forgespec/forgespec.db`): Full path to SQLite database.
